escena: SCENE (team portrait, Ciudad de México, a strategy director between two client sessions): a striking editorial portrait of a Mexican woman in her late thirties, short dark hair, plain charcoal knit, seated, turned three-quarters, looking out of frame to the left with calm intensity; a hard low key light from the left through venetian blinds throws crisp graphic stripes of light and shadow across her face and knit, the far side of her face in open shadow; a rim from a second low source behind separates her hair from the wall. 135mm lens at f/2, focus on her eyes. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) notebook under her hand carries the only blue. Nobody looks at the lens.

lecho.objeto: the edge of a dark oiled-wood desk on the camera side, dissolved into blur and outside every beam

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed plaster wall
